name: Recordist
description: Read and search the meetings Recordist recorded on your own Mac, with their transcripts, notes and action items, and start or stop a recording. The gateway talks only to the Recordist app on 127.0.0.1 and listens on loopback by default. What it returns goes to the AI assistant you connect, which may send it to its own cloud model.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Get one meeting with its notes and action items.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Full-text search across transcripts and notes.

tools.name: get_action_items
tools.description: List action items across meetings, optionally only the open ones.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Start a recording. Works only when Allow agents to start recordings is on in Recordist's Settings → Integrations; it is off by default.

tools.name: add_marker
tools.description: Add a marker at the current moment of a recording.

tools.name: regenerate_notes
tools.description: Regenerate a meeting's notes with a template, using the AI provider set in Recordist, which may be a cloud service.
